planner_input.description: Autonomous smoke and assertion validations suite

project_analysis.summary: The application is a login page for LeetCode, an online platform for practicing programming problems.
project_analysis.main_purpose: To allow users to log in and access the platform's features

smoke_tests: Verify that the login page loads successfully
regression_tests: Test the login functionality with valid credentials
Test the login functionality with invalid credentials
boundary_tests: Test the login form with boundary values for username and password (e.g., minimum/maximum length)
negative_tests: Test the login functionality with empty fields
Test the login functionality with special characters in username/password
accessibility_tests: Audit the login page for accessibility standards
integration_tests: Verify that the login form integrates correctly with the backend authentication service
system_tests: Test the system's ability to handle multiple concurrent users logging in simultaneously
ui_tests: Check the visual appearance of the login page and its elements
functional_tests: Verify that the login form functions correctly under various conditions (e.g., network latency, browser compatibility)
exploratory_tests: Explore alternative user flows for logging in (e.g., using social media accounts)
compatibility_tests: Test the login page on multiple browsers and devices
security_tests: Perform security checks to ensure that the login form is secure against common vulnerabilities (e.g., SQL injection, cross-site scripting)
performance_test_suggestions: Audit the login page's performance under load conditions
api_test_suggestions: Load test the backend authentication service endpoints

business_workflow: User logs in to access programming problems and solutions
user_workflow: Navigate to login page, enter credentials, submit form
critical_user_journeys: User logs in with valid credentials
functional_requirements: The login form must accept valid username and password combinations
The login form must reject invalid username and password combinations
The login form must handle empty fields gracefully
The login form must handle special characters in username/password
non_functional_requirements: The login page must load within a specified time limit
The login form must be accessible to users with disabilities
